questions.question: If 9 × 4 of 3 ÷ 2 - 5 × Q + 2 × 3 = 10, then find the value of Q.
questions.solution:
**Concept Used:**

BODMAS = Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction

**Calculation:**

⇒ 9 × 4 of 3 ÷ 2 - 5 × Q + 2 × 3 = 10

⇒ 9 × 12 ÷ 2 - 5 × Q + 2 × 3 = 10

⇒ 9 × 6 - 5 × Q + 2 × 3 = 10

⇒ 54 - 5Q + 6 = 10

⇒ 5Q = 60 – 10 = 50

⇒ Q=(50)/(5)=10

**Hence, the value of Q is 10**

questions.question: The value of (5+7times 5div 8 of 5+3div 3times 5)/(6div 6 of 4+9times 9div 3times 2times 2) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(5+7times 5div 8 of 5+3div 3times 5)/(6div 6 of 4+9times 9div 3times 2times 2)

**Formula used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule (Bracket, Order, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction) to solve the expression.

**Calculations:**

**Numerator:** 5 + 7 times 5 div 8 of 5 + 3 div 3 times 5

⇒ 5 + 7 times 5 div 40 + 1 times 5

⇒ 5 + (7)/(8) + 5

⇒ (40 + 7 + 40)/(8)

⇒ (87)/(8)

**Denominator:** 6 div 6 of 4 + 9 times 9 div 3 times 2 times 2

⇒ 6 div 24 + 9 times 3 times 2 times 2

⇒ (1)/(4) + 108

⇒ (1 + 432)/(4) 

⇒ (433)/(4) 

**Final Expression: **

⇒(87/8)/(433/4) 

⇒ 87 / 866

**∴ The value of the expression is 87 / 866.**
